items.title: [Highlight] 40-year-old Dirk Nowitzki nails the jumper over Drew Eubanks for the final shot of his NBA career. Gregg Popovich is clapping on the sideline. 4/10/19
items.author: MrBuckBuck
items.body_excerpt: He finished the game with 20 Points on 8/21 FG (38.1%), 2/6 from 3 (33.3%), 2/2 FT, 10 Rebounds, 1 Assist, 1 Steal, 2 PF, and a +/- of -11 in 31:33 minutes played. A day earlier, he scored 30 points vs. the Suns (11/31 FG, 5/14 from 3, 3/3 FT, 8 Rebounds, 3 Assists (2 TOV), 1…
